text.name: Servine

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

text.name: Pansage
text.flavor: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

text.name: Dwebble

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

text.name: Pignite

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a {Fire} Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.flavor: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

text.name: Dewott

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

text.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

text.name: Woobat

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

text.name: Drilbur

attacks.name: Hone Claws
attacks.text: During your next turn, each of this Pokémon's attacks does 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

text.name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

text.name: Scraggy
text.flavor: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

text.name: Klang

attacks.name: Metal Sound
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

text.name: Axew

attacks.name: Dual Chop
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

text.flavor: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
